plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Art - Design A.A. Degree - CalGETC' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 19, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8020/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61 = 15+15+15+16 (all semester headers match their rows; verified). List A (minimum 6 units): ART 301 Digital Drawing and Composition, ART 338 Introduction to Digital Painting I, ART 325 Introduction to Graphic Design (requires ART 320 or placement by assessment), ARTNM 324 Digital Design (advisory: ART 300, ART 320, CISC 302, or JOUR 330) — one 3-unit selection sequenced in each of Semesters 3 and 4; a different course per slot; map recommends ART 325 or ARTNM 324. List B (minimum 3 units): ARTH C1100, ARTH 309 (advisory ENGL C1000), ARTH 311, ARTH 312, ARTH 332 (advisory ENGL C1000) — one 3-unit selection sequenced in each of Semesters 2 and 3 (map recommends ARTH 309 for the Semester 2 slot and ARTH 311 for the Semester 3 slot; ARTH 311 is also a required course in Semester 3, so a different List B course should be chosen there). Option-specific prerequisites and advisories documented here, not encoded on the slots. CalGETC Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor. Semester 2 'CalGETC Area 3B-Humanitites' row is a typo; encoded 3B.
